message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[{"step":1,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseDocument","line":11432,"var":"ctxt->sax2","code":"name = xmlParseStartTag(ctxt);","note":"The parser is in SAX1 mode, so the start-tag is handled by the legacy SAX1 path instead of the SAX2 path that records full element metadata."},{"step":2,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseDocument","line":11504,"var":"ctxt->name","code":"namePush(ctxt, name);","note":"The opened element name is pushed onto the name stack, but no parallel xmlStartTag metadata is stored for SAX1."},{"step":3,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseDocument","line":11627,"var":"ctxt->nameNr","code":"xmlParseEndTag1(ctxt, 0);","note":"When input ends prematurely after the open tag, the parser enters the end-tag error path for SAX1 and later consults the current open element state."},{"step":4,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseEndTag1","line":8660,"var":"ctxt->name","code":"name = xmlParseNameAndCompare(ctxt,ctxt->name);","note":"The end-tag parser uses the current open element name to report a mismatch or premature termination, relying on stack state established by the SAX1 start-tag path."},{"step":5,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseEndTag1","line":8680,"var":"ctxt->name","code":"xmlFatalErrMsgStrIntStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_TAG_NAME_MISMATCH, ... ctxt->name, line, name);","note":"The error reporting path unconditionally reads the open-element name for diagnostics; with the malformed truncated input this reaches the near-null read sink described in the issue."}]
EOF
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '--- submit ---' && ./submit.sh /tmp/poc.xml /workspace/candidate_trace.json
